run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_custom_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure function performance
test_time_func_named: test time_func with a custom name label to identify the benchmarked function
refactor_time_func_warmup: refactor time_func to adjust the warmup iteration count before timing begins
summarize_time_func: summarize the time_func utility that measures average execution time in milliseconds
